reply_lines: A variable is like a labeled box. You put one thing inside and give it a name!
What would you put in your box?
Great thinking! A good name tells you what is in the box.
Like 'score' or 'pet' — pick a name you will remember.
Boxes can hold a number like 7, or a word like 'dog'.
That is the whole point — let the box remember it for you!
You can swap what is inside a box any time you want!
The new thing replaces the old one.
Hi! I am Claude. Let us plan our magic boxes together.
